correctness.rationale: The source endpoint estimates imply all inner endpoints are o(1/t); inserting this into the exact outer-edge ODE gives c_n t b_n -> 1, from which the L1 top-hat limit and moment hierarchy follow. The one-step a/b^2 and logarithmic corrections follow from an integrable exact logarithmic derivative and asymptotic integration, with symbolic and numerical checks.

originality.rationale: The claim is restricted to a quantitative sharpening of arXiv:2609.20674v1. The source gives only comparability and an unspecified separation exponent, and no matching rescaled top-hat, exact coefficient, quadratic edge-slaving, or logarithmic correction was located in repository or external searches. The 2025 general long-time paper remains the principal residual literature risk because its complete body was not exhaustively rechecked.

value.rationale: The result supplies an explicit renormalized normal form and universal mass/moment clocks for the finite step packets that are the building blocks of the source construction, plus a sharp subleading law in the elementary one-step problem.

disclaimer: Not independent validation, peer review, or a guarantee of first discovery.
